gaps.sentence: I'm learning ___ the guitar at the moment.
gaps.explanation: learn takes the to-infinitive (learn how to play).

gaps.sentence: They managed ___ the fire before it spread.
gaps.explanation: manage takes the to-infinitive: managed to put out.

gaps.sentence: He went on ___ even after the audience had left.
gaps.explanation: go on + -ing = continue the same activity; go on to do = do something next.

gaps.sentence: This new timetable will mean ___ earlier trains.
I look forward to ___ your suggestions at the meeting.
I tried ___ the shelf up, but it was too heavy.
gaps.explanation: try + to-infinitive = attempt, make an effort.

gaps.sentence: I really can't afford ___ on holiday this year.
gaps.explanation: afford takes the to-infinitive: can't afford to go.

gaps.sentence: Would you like ___ now or later?
gaps.explanation: would like takes the to-infinitive: would like to eat.
